## Change / Что изменено

## Related issue / Связанный Issue

## Why this is needed / Зачем

## Tests actually run / Реально выполненные тесты

## Network / platform behavior / Влияние на сеть и платформы

## Security / Безопасность

- [ ] No secrets, private deploy URLs or raw traffic have been committed.
- [ ] Relevant RU and EN documentation is updated, or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Failure/cancellation/resource cleanup behavior was considered where applicable.
